name: Ulf Bengtsson

His breakthrough on the international stage came with the European Youth Championship doubles gold in 1977, followed by senior European Championship bronze in doubles in 1982 at age 22.

name: Zakir Hussain
milestone_by_age_26: Began his professional career at age 12 performing in concerts and touring, and made his US debut at the Fillmore East in New York with Ravi Shankar in 1970 at age 18-19, all well before age 26.
early_history_summary: Hussain was born in Bombay in 1951 to Ustad Alla Rakha, one of the most celebrated tabla players in Indian classical music history. He began formal training at age seven with three hours of daily tuition from his father, started performing in concerts at age seven, and began touring professionally at age twelve. He made his American debut at the Fillmore East in New York with Ravi Shankar in 1970 at age 18-19, substituting for his ill father.
family_context_summary: Born to Ustad Alla Rakha Qureshi, one of the most celebrated tabla players in Indian classical music history. He was the eldest son and grew up immersed in music 24 hours a day, with intensive daily training from his father.
parent_family_domain_summary: His father Alla Rakha was a legendary tabla player who accompanied Ravi Shankar and was a leading figure in the Punjab gharana. Alla Rakha provided intensive daily training from age seven, directly transferring domain expertise at the highest level.

evidence_summary: Zakir Hussain was born into the household of Ustad Alla Rakha, one of the greatest tabla players in history, who provided intensive daily training from age seven (three hours each morning). He began performing in concerts at age seven and touring professionally at twelve. His US debut at the Fillmore East with Ravi Shankar in 1970 at age 18-19 came about when he substituted for his ill father.
